logic.bm: Pure-play transformer maker, 30 kVA–1,200 MVA up to 765 kV (2023 brochure; "Status: December 2022"): large power transformers >100–1,200 MVA incl. GSU, autotransformers, grid transformers, phase shifters, shunt/series reactors (Royal SMIT Nijmegen; RETRASIB Sibiu 20–300 MVA MPT, 120–400 MVA autos); medium power 5–150 MVA (SGB Regensburg), 2.5–16 MVA (SBG Neumark), 2.5–40 MVA (SGB MY); oil distribution 50–2,500 kVA and compact substations 160–2,500 kVA (Neumark, Nilai, Botoșani 50–1,000 kVA); cast-resin dry-type 50 kVA–25 MVA (Regensburg), 50–5,000 kVA (Nilai), 250–5,000 kVA (Chennai), Olomouc, Changzhou, Louisville OH (US assembly, to 25 MVA); VPI/LV dry-type & reactors (BCV France); US oil-filled new/reman 5–100 MVA (OTC, new up to 30 MVA/138 kV), Southwest Electric (oil-filled, repair). Group scale: "€729 million in sales in 2016" (BC Partners 2017-04-24); SGB-USA Oct-2022 deck: "2021 figures ... $1.1B in Sales: $200M from Dry Type"; >3,600 employees; 12 production facilities incl. 7 dry-type.
logic.recognition: 제품 출하·고객 검수 또는 프로젝트 진행률의 회사 공시 기준을 대사. 수주액·수주잔고·수출통계는 매출과 별도.
logic.bridge: 이미 인식한 누적 매출 + 납기별 기초 수주잔고 전환 + 당기 수주 중 인도 가능한 물량. 생산능력·취소·검수·환율을 별도 가정.
gates: 공시 실적 타깃 없음(비상장·미공시) — 프로필과 경로 프록시만 표시

structural_breaks.note: Majority of RETRASIB S.A. (Sibiu, RO) and Trafo Project (Bucharest) acquired.

One Equity Partners completes acquisition of SGB-SMIT (terms undisclosed); then "six production sites in Germany, the Netherlands, Romania, Malaysia and the U.S.". Seller (funds advised by BC Partners) and signing date 2017-04-24 are from the BC Partners release https://www.bcpartners.com/news/bc-partners-to-sell-sgb-smit-the-largest-independent-pure-play-manufacturer-of-transformers-to-one-equity-partners/ — the OEP completion release does not name the seller.
Start-up of SGB China, SGB Transformers India, SGB Czech Trafo (cast resin).
BCV Technologies (Fontenay-le-Comte, FR; dry-type VPI/cast resin/reactors) acquired.
SGB-USA cast-resin production in Louisville, OH "Beginning in Q2 2023" (planned, per Oct-2022 deck; HV coils imported from Malaysia, up to 5 MVA/34.5 kV).
Agreement to acquire Southwest Electric Co. (Oklahoma City; oil-filled transformers, repair, switchgear; facilities Tulsa, Nashville, Louisville OH); closing expected Q1 2025.
SGB-ALFA (JV with Electro-Alfa International, BVB: EAI) Botoșani, RO: production began July 2025 (oil distribution 50–1,000 kVA/30 kV); ~EUR 20M; inaugurated 2026-07-01 with >1,300 units built.
Signed majority stake in COMEL Transformatori (Ripanj/Belgrade, RS; power transformers); closing expected H2 2026.
